from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in comp); r1 = max(y for y, x in comp)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in comp); c1 = max(x for y, x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                      if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(comp) != border:
                continue
            # The cavity is 2 when both interior side lengths are even; otherwise 7.
            fill = 2 if ((r1-r0-1) % 2 == 0 and (c1-c0-1) % 2 == 0) else 7
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-75f352df.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
